title: AtMem proposed architecture work records
description: Proposal format1 is separate from the saved architecture work state version. Use stable mapping IDs: a later artifact can propose explicit revisions of its own previous agent-proposed mappings, retaining prior artifact values. Proposals cannot overwrite client requirements, diagram, ownership, imported/user mappings or accepted decisions. References use block:, requirement:, assumption:, question:, decision:, interface:, work: prefixes plus exact IDs. Implementation records name nonempty data.files of actual relative delivered files; evidence records may name their test files the same way. Supplied pinned inputs and the proposal file are not implementation/evidence files. All records remain unreviewed proposals on import. Evidence data is a claim/reference, never authenticated execution or acceptance.
